body:
As I formulated this experiment, I knew its potential and almost feared it. I understood the true power of the two chosen compounds but was unable to predict any sort of combined outcome. I had four others, who I might add also saw the Museum as I did, go before me and tell me of their travel. I repaired myself of this uncertainty and meticulously prepared the bowl for myself using marshmallow leaf as the base. I layered Mexican DMT over that. Then salvia 30x and salvia 20x. Then Brazilian DMT and last but not least, more Mexican DMT on top. My brother was left to observe me when I decided to do this. He reported seeing me laying for about five minutes then a second shorter coherent moment of about six minutes before I fully returned to tell him about it.
The experiment took place in a four by eight foot shiny grow tent that is my bed room and I incinerated the potion with a hot rot heated by torch and inhaled through an elaborates challis for smoking this particular sacred substance.
I sat back against the shiny wall of the tent. All of a sudden the wall was a wheelbarrow and the elves had tipped me backwards through the wall on to an assembly line. They said things like 'excuse me, pardon me, watch out.' I was poked in the Eye with an umbrella of different colors repeatedly, which the elf told me 'it's just the way that it is,' and 'I'm sorry, come again.' As the umbrella entered my eye I heard 'pick a color.' A quick choice of orange resulted in an orange umbrella stuck in my eye and opened. Inside the umbrella was a room that I was allowed to see, full of sacred objects and mystical geometry of great importance. All of this well on an assembly line at Santa's workshop. There where millions of elves working at a million work stations, all with important jobs. As the elves kept moving me from room to room, showing me all the artifacts in the psychedelic museum. They were telling me that this was important and to remember these objects.
At one point I was sure only half of me was real and that the real half had grabbed everything around me in the tent and was ripping it into little tiny peaces uncontrollably. I was convinced that my friends where taking things out of my hands so I wouldn't break them. This was not the case, I was still motionless on the bed according to my brother. I decided to close my eyes, though I assume they were still closed already, and the gnome flipped the wheelbarrow backwards and I was on the moving assembly line again, rotating along a track. Like it was a key to unlocking the greatest power in the universe.
After five minutes I stumbled back to reality and made my way to the couch where I sat for another six minutes as my brain reassembled it's self. My speech returned and I finished comprehending what had just happened to me. Then I told my brother all about it. The adrenalin from remembering and sharing this experience is overwhelming, even a day later. The word hallucination does not apply anymore to this experience. It was real and not a pseudo-hallucination like other experiences. The most incredible part was how all of this experience was vividly retained in memory and all with in eleven minutes.
This isn't the cherry on top, its the space above the cherry. I am an experienced diver with 102 different compounds on my belt of experience, but this was not like anything I ever experienced before. The intake of the two substances at the same time takes your brain and says 'this is a deck of cards,' cuts the deck and shuffles it and puts it back in place. Holy shit mother of Jesus, what kind of redonkulous voodoo hocus-pocus nonsense did I stumble upon this time.
This is not to be taken lightly. I would imagine an unstable psyche would not survive without suffering trauma or change to ones personality. I can say I'm changed and have not had an urge to repeat this experiment or another experiment for that matter. I do not regret this at all. It can only be described as the reality marble. Definitely a +4 or beyond.
